title: test_channel.py: Wraparound test does not verify wrapping semantics
description: Line 101: test_sfn_wrapping claims to test that 0x100000000 'Wraps to 0' but the assertion only checks the output is in valid range [1,63]. Python integers do not automatically wrap at 32-bits. To actually verify wrapping, the test should assert ch2 == synchronized_hop_channel(0, seed=0, n_channels=64). As written, the test passes whether or not the implementation performs 32-bit wrapping.
